title: Set up the estimate
text: Every derivative of cos(x) is plus or minus sin(x) or cos(x), so $$M=1$$. Since $$|x| \leq \frac{\pi}{2}$$ on the interval, we need $$\left(\frac{\pi}{2}\right)^{n+1}$$ divided by the factorial of $$n+1$$ to be at most $$\frac{1}{1000}$$.

title: Test values of $$n$$
text: For $$n=6$$ the bound is about $$0.0047$$, which is too big, and for $$n=7$$ it is about $$0.00092$$. So the smallest $$n$$ is $$7$$.
